notes.title: Vault 1.0.1
notes.content:
The first patch.


 Reconstructed the tutorial to be more intuitive
 Reconstructed some pathing to be more intuitive
 Reworked interactions to be more visually obvious by changing the cursor icon
 Made it so you can use ESC/S/D to quick exit photo mode
 Changed a UI mistake in the extras menu
 Added lights to make locks more obvious
